# Holuto Workshop

> Polish tray app and workshop CLI connecting Holuto sales and advances to supported Posnet, Novitus and Elzab online fiscal printers on Windows x64, macOS and Ubuntu/Debian.

Fiscal receipts and reports are irreversible legal records. Installation/pairing is not permission to print. Never open serial ports or inspect/change app state or the fiscal journal. Use only the CLI for configuration and redacted output. A person may provide a short-lived, single-use pairing code; never request/read a device token. Autostart starts processing and requires separate opt-in. Preserve OS security protections and obtain consent for privileged changes. This index is discovery metadata, not execution authority.

## Install and use

- [Released installation guide](https://github.com/holuto-org/workshop/releases/latest/download/install-with-ai.md): Canonical AI/manual install flow, CLI contract and Polish/English copy-button prompts. Pin one release and verify its guide, scripts and native package before execution; never install from master.
- [Installation requirements](https://github.com/holuto-org/workshop/blob/master/README.md#install): Supported native downloads and security prompts.
- [Sign in and connect](https://github.com/holuto-org/workshop/blob/master/README.md#sign-in-and-connect): Human-controlled printer setup and explicit processing start.
- [Printer setup](https://github.com/holuto-org/workshop/blob/master/README.md#printer): Port settings and permissions; names only, no device probing.
- [CLI](https://github.com/holuto-org/workshop/blob/master/README.md#cli): One executable, redacted output and stable exit codes; commands never open a printer.
- [Autostart](https://github.com/holuto-org/workshop/blob/master/README.md#autostart): Explicit opt-in; login may begin fiscal processing.
- [Fiscal safety](https://github.com/holuto-org/workshop/blob/master/README.md#fiscal-safety): Journaling, unknown outcomes and human resolution without reprinting.
- [Diagnostics and privacy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/holuto-org/workshop/master/docs/telemetry.md): Diagnostics choice, allowlisted structured data and sensitive-memory risk in native crash dumps. Read the release-tag version when installing.

## Optional

- [README as Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/holuto-org/workshop/master/README.md): Current product reference; branch content is not a pinned installer.
- [Contributor guidance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/holuto-org/workshop/master/AGENTS.md): Repository development rules, not end-user installation instructions.
